reason: The returns and UL listing are better than I expected, but $360 to a store I have never heard of with almost no reviews is a lot, and 2 to 3 weeks of shipping would land right when my electrician shows up. I would pin it and see if the store still exists in a few months.
objection: I can't tell if this is a real, established shop or a dropshipper with a nice website, and I would be hanging $360 over my new kitchen on that guess.
would_change_my_mind: Photos from real buyers with the light hung in an actual kitchen, plus a confirmed delivery date that clears my electrician with a week to spare.
